aug_2026_smp.published: 11 Aug 2026; forecast table finalized 5 Aug. Summary table reports year-ended (not September-quarter) forecasts: Dec 2026 CPI 3.6%, trimmed mean 3.3%, unemployment 4.5%; June 2026 3.9%, 3.6%, 4.4% respectively. Cash-rate forecast assumption uses market expectations as of 5 Aug. This forecast predates the 29 Sep decision and the 30 Sep release of Aug CPI; it is not a later forecast update. No Sep-quarter inflation estimate appears in this captured summary table.

latest_governor_transcript_located.published_event: Michele Bullock, Governor, monetary-policy decision press conference, Sydney, 29 Sep 2026, following the same-day decision; RBA source identifies this as Governor media conference.
latest_governor_transcript_located.relevant_answers: Asked whether the Board considered a pause or 50bp move, Bullock said: “We considered holding and 25 basis points.” Asked whether the next inflation figure would avert a November hike, she said the figure was one piece of backward-looking information and: “I’m not going to give you forward guidance.” She described forward-looking inflation pressure and financial conditions as the focus. This is the 29 Sep press conference, not a post-29-Sep-date speech.

cpi_timing_caveat: RBA 29 Sep meeting was before ABS Aug CPI publication on 30 Sep. September minutes discuss July inflation data. Do not count the subsequently released Aug CPI as information already incorporated in that decision.
